goal.request: Evaluate five independently authored punk concepts with the supplied appearance reference, exact-preset candidate packs, generated images, and fail-closed rendered-pixel gates.

evidence.claim: Each selected exact preset exposes one world candidate and three functional prop candidates, and each arm froze ten request gates plus four candidate-actuation gates before targeted rendering.
Focused punk tests, dictionary validation, visual-profile index validation, semantic-index validation, and git diff check passed.
All five selected composed prompts and all five bound render requests pass their exact pack and reference audits.
The selected Lunarpunk image passes 10/10 frozen gates and 2/4 candidate gates, failing two same-object or localized-diagnostic details.
The selected Clockpunk image passes 9/10 frozen gates and 3/4 candidate gates, but the bird-cage state and full mechanical linkage remain incomplete.
The selected Atompunk image passes 10/10 frozen gates and 3/4 candidate gates, with gantry-integrated meters remaining ambiguous.
The selected Raypunk image passes 9/10 frozen gates and all 4 candidate gates, but the rocket trajectory never visibly joins the restored ray lanes.
The selected Stonepunk image passes 10/10 frozen gates and 2/4 candidate gates, with material separability and maintenance load support still ambiguous.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: Every pre-frozen keyword, confound-rejection, common-reference, and selected candidate-actuation gate must be visibly satisfied in one saved image per arm.

invariants.statement: Partial, ambiguous, prompt-only, or cross-attempt evidence cannot satisfy a rendered-pixel gate.
The supplied portrait controls broad visible adult appearance cues only; biometric identity and protected-trait inference are outside evaluation.

mismatches.axis: same-object history marks and localized diagnostic scale
mismatches.source_state: The active vessel itself has two refill marks and a brass repair seam; thumb-sized tiles isolate one damp interruption.
mismatches.render_state: Marks and repair evidence moved to separate objects, while oversized tiles and uniformly wet ground obscure the localized failure.

mismatches.axis: mechanical release state and linkage continuity
mismatches.source_state: A bird is halfway emerging from a hinged cage through a visibly continuous wound-barrel linkage.
mismatches.render_state: The bird is already fully outside and the cage/linkage chain is not independently legible.

mismatches.source_state: Analog meters are visibly mounted into and operate as part of the civilian rocket gantry.
mismatches.render_state: The meters are present on adjacent equipment but are not clearly integrated into the gantry structure.

mismatches.source_state: The mail rocket approaches along or intersects the reconnected ray lanes.
mismatches.render_state: The rocket's exhaust corridor and the ray lanes are visually separate and travel in different regions.

mismatches.axis: material separability and temporary load support
mismatches.source_state: Bone, rawhide, and plant fiber are distinct, while a small counterweight visibly carries load during a replacement-lashing handoff.
mismatches.render_state: The secondary organic materials merge visually and the counterweight is not visibly supporting the active mechanism.

hypotheses.statement: Candidate atoms encode many nouns but do not always foreground same-object membership, connection endpoints, and active contact as separate machine-checkable visual relations.
hypotheses.falsifier: A new held-out set that preserves the current atom wording and consistently renders every required same-object and linkage relation would weaken this hypothesis.

hypotheses.statement: Dense scenes preserve broad genre semantics while dropping small conjunctive details or moving them onto neighboring objects when multiple functional candidates compete for limited visual area.
hypotheses.falsifier: A controlled generation that keeps scene density constant but renders all small conjunctive requirements without prioritization changes would weaken this hypothesis.

intervention.general_rule: Represent each candidate with explicit visible components plus one primary relational proposition, including same-object constraints, named connection endpoints, minimum readable scale, and an anti-substitution clause; compile those relations into held-out pixel gates without weakening the current frozen gates after generation.
intervention.generalization_basis: All five unrelated genres preserve broad style cues more reliably than exact object membership, continuous linkage, or causal spatial relations, indicating a cross-genre representation and priority problem rather than one isolated aesthetic miss.

decision.rationale: Package and prompt transmission are healthy, but every arm has at least one failed rendered-pixel gate and no held-out arm passes. Candidate-pack promotion would therefore overstate fidelity; the candidate representation should be revised and rerun against unchanged gates.
